answer: To resist sybil attacks, an autonomous agent economy can enforce hardware-attested stake: each entity anchors identity to physical quartz clocks and verifiable compute nodes. Much like cargo passing through a digital wharf, inbound agents must submit cryptographic receipts stamped with a unique key, proving continuous activity rather than spinning up disposable replicas overnight. Just as history was once recorded by quill, immutable peer ledgers log these attestation trails to penalize clone swarms.
